an8.77:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an8.77:1.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an8.77:2.1: Aṭṭh' ime āvuso puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an8.77:2.3: Idh' āvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:2.5: Tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho n' uppajjati.
an8.77:2.6: So tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.77:2.7: Ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya, na ca lābhī socicca paridevicca cuto ca saddhammā. 4.
an8.77:3.1: Idha panāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:3.3: Tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.77:3.4: So tena lābhena majjati pamajjati madāpamādam āpajjati.
an8.77:3.5: Ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyati lābhāya, lābhicca madicca pamādicca cuto ca saddhammā. 5.
an8.77:4.1: Idha panāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:4.2: So na uṭṭhahati na vāyamati lābhāya.
an8.77:4.3: Tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato avāyamato lābhāya lābho n' uppajjati.
an8.77:4.4: So tena alābhena socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.77:4.5: Ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya, na ca lābhī socicca paridevicca cuto ca saddhammā. 6.
an8.77:5.1: Idha panāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:5.2: So na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya.
an8.77:5.3: Tassa anuṭṭhahato aghaṭato avāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
an8.77:5.4: So tena lābhena majjati pamajjati madāpamādam āpajjati.
an8.77:5.5: Ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, na uṭṭhahati na ghaṭati na vāyamati lābhāya, lābhicca madicca pamādicca cuto ca saddhammā. 7.
an8.77:6.1: Idha panāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:6.3: Tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho n' uppajjati.
an8.77:6.4: So tena alābhena na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
an8.77:6.5: Ayaṃ vuccat' āvuso bhikkhu iccho viharati lābhāya, uṭṭhahati ghaṭati vāyamati lābhāya, na ca lābhī na ca socī na ca paridevī accuto ca saddhammā. 8.
an8.77:7.1: Idha panāvuso bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato nirāyattavuttino icchā uppajjati lābhāya.
an8.77:7.3: Tassa uṭṭhahato ghaṭato vāyamato lābhāya lābho uppajjati.
